text:
This week, the White House hosted a UFC fight on its South Lawn, Royal Marines boarded a Russian shadow fleet oil tanker, and a schoolgirl said she would be left staring at a wall if social media was banned for under-16s.

But how much attention did you pay to what else happened in the world over the past seven days?

Quiz collated by George Sandeman.

Fancy some more? Try last week's quiz, or have a go at something from the archives.

Spectators at Glasgow's OVO Hydro were treated to exhilarating performances during New Zealand's 61-54 win over England.

Alex Jenkinson, 39, is accused of causing the former Duke of York to "fear unlawful violence" as he walked his dogs.

Earlier this month, a judge ruled against a group - which includes the Duke of Sussex and Sir Elton John - after they sued the Daily Mail's publisher.

The King will need a new private secretary, with Sir Clive Alderton stepping down next year.

The prince's warning comes as wildfires rage in parts of Europe and the UK during a spell of extreme heat.
